bio: Felix Schellhorn has succeeded his father Sepp as the new head chef at the restaurant of Der Seehof hotel, a renowned art-focused establishment nestled in a hamlet by the lake – Goldegger Moorsee. A single set menu is served – this changes daily, taking its cue from the seasons and showcasing good-quality regional ingredients. The charming interior features delightfully unique decorative details with endearing individual furnishing details. Tables on the terrace are also much in demand....
